### Barotropic QG checkpoint

- The same diagnostic sequence now handles one-family QG state and the existing resolved barotropic forcing instances. The four spatial kernel operations can capture their raw output instead of projecting each contribution; the diagnostic sequence projects their cumulative stage once. The ordinary RHS follows its existing path.
- Raw diagnostic Fourier inversion preserves horizontal means and takes the real part at self-conjugate modes. Ordinary QGPV reconstruction still masks the mean. A dedicated nonzero-mean test distinguishes these behaviors.
- Release and Apple ASan/UBSan `forcing-tendencies` and `barotropic-qg-forcing` passed. Tests cover independent nonlinear products, stage accumulation, one shared physical reconstruction, exact unchanged state/later RHS, unchanged retained storage, selected-only evaluation, late FFT failure and retry, raw/state alias rejection, and nonfinite-state rejection. The existing wave cases run alongside QG to cover the shared sequence change.
- MATLAB R2025b `fullGridBarotropicTendenciesMatchMatlab` passed for barotropic and equivalent-barotropic (`j=0/1`) configurations, odd/even rectangular grids, antialiasing on/off, and six/seven-force compositions. Both reference and native FFTW passed 104 field comparisons; maximum relative error was `2.342e-14`. No MATLAB runtime code changed.
- Discovered and reproduced MATLAB stratified-QG `SpatialForcingOperation` using `[Nz,Nkl]` Fourier rows at a boundary that requires `[Nj,Nkl]` modal rows. With `[8,6,9]`, `Nj=4`, and nonlinear plus adaptive forcing, MATLAB R2025b raises `MATLAB:sizeDimensionsMustMatch` at `WVAdaptiveDamping.m:334`, called from `SpatialForcingOperation.m:63`. The inverse side also omits vertical reconstruction. Reported as [#404](https://github.com/JeffreyEarly/wave-vortex-model/issues/404), with reproduction and compatibility requirements. Ordinary stratified-QG `nonlinearFlux` uses the correct vertical projection. This existing MATLAB defect must be explicitly represented in the eventual #315 qualification; it does not justify silently weakening comparisons or changing MATLAB behavior.
- MATLAB Code Analyzer passed for the updated parity test, and whitespace checks passed. Source changes after the numerical comparisons only add invalid-state/storage rejection; the positive numerical paths are unchanged.
- Stratified-QG numerical diagnostics and all end-to-end field/observer/output work remain incomplete. The full #315 goal remains active.

- All six transform configurations passed nonlinear saved-output parity in 48 reference/native scenarios (17,280 field-record comparisons; maximum normalized error 2.337e-13). Each scenario additionally ran the same nonlinear model with ordinary u/v output and identical normal/dense schedules. Every saved primary coefficient, accepted/rejected step and RHS count, integrator error/step/constraint metric, and frozen forcing metadata matched exactly. Fixed RK4, segmented restart/append, adaptive RK45 and RK78 are covered.
- Added 16 SQG spectral-output scenarios with all nine stable forcings, linear and nonlinear dynamics, and both providers. These passed 1,728 field-record comparisons (maximum normalized error 7.591e-13). A test-only WVOperation exposes the existing MATLAB forcing and modal-transform primitives with the published wrapper metadata; the original wrapper's #404 failure is asserted explicitly. No MATLAB runtime code changed. A first fixture selected a zero horizontal-mean fixed amplitude and measured only roundoff; selecting a populated Kh>0, J=1 mode makes this diagnostic nondegenerate.
- Extended the actual NetCDF sibling-route retry regression with nonzero Fu/Fv/Feta from the model's resolved nonlinear forcing engine. The first destination commits and the second fails, retaining exactly one prepared occurrence. Retrying adds no diagnostic evaluations, FFTs or integration work, preserves all accepted coefficients, writes identical finite sibling fields, commits exact schedule cursors, leaves the restart source byte-identical, and frees output storage on completion.
- The old persistence fixture's large amplitudes became nonfinite during its one-second RK4 steps. Scaling its coefficients by 1e-6 keeps the fixture stable while retaining nonzero nonlinear output. Release and Apple ASan/UBSan model-output-netcdf passed. The nonlinear numerical matrix passed before an AGROW-only analyzer failure; replacing the equivalent concatenation with a literal fixed it. ## Diagnostic semantics established from MATLAB

`Operations/SpatialForcingOperation.m` reports the difference before and after each operation in stage/priority order. Spatial diagnostics expose the raw spatial contribution; spectral and amplitude diagnostics reconstruct the difference in the accumulated spectral tendency. Filters and fixed-amplitude operations therefore require the preceding accumulated tendency. Evaluating each forcing independently from a zero accumulator is incorrect.

The diagnostic execution must use the existing resolved forcing instances and coarse operation services. Instance identity and output metadata must be bound before evaluation. Scratch belongs to the observation occurrence, and diagnostic execution must not restore constrained amplitudes or change accepted integration state. Projection must preserve the distinction between raw spatial contributions and reconstructed spectral contributions.

Local implementation and qualification are complete. Required hosted checks and integration are tracked by [#315](https://github.com/JeffreyEarly/wave-vortex-model/issues/315).
